How to get it :
- [[Electrolyser|Electrolyser]] (x3) : Starmetal Crystals.
- [[Cyclotron|Cyclotron]] : [[gv:part_lithium|Box of Lithium Dust]], Polonium-210 Powder.
- [[Centrifuge|Centrifuge]] (x2) : Starmetal Crystals.

Used to make :
[[gv:powder_actinium|Actinium Powder]].
